cards.subject: The Shrine of Eldretharr
lines: A Highborne shrine stood in the heart of this wing, and it held an artifact of fertility.
Alzzin corrupted the shrine, and that is where his hold over the forest comes from. The wing is a greenhouse now. The shrine is still under it.

cards.subject: This was the front door
lines: In vanilla the Crescent Key opens the doors into the West and North wings, and the only source of that key is an imp in here.
East is not the optional wing. Every tribute run and every trip to the library starts by chasing him.
The key requirement was removed in 4.0.3a.

cards.subject: You do not pull him. You talk to him.
lines: He is not a boss you engage. You speak to him, he flees deeper into the wing, you catch him and speak again. Four times.
Only then does he turn, grow, and fight.
"If you want the key, you'll have to catch me!"

cards.subject: His name is an insult
lines: A coward by name and by design.
The buff he takes when he finally turns and fights is called Spirit of Runn Tum. The recipe he drops is Runn Tum Tuber Surprise.
He powers up on his own cooking.

cards.subject: He robbed the one who got out
lines: Azj'Tordin is a Shen'dralar who walked out of Eldre'Thalas rather than live under the prince. He gave up immortality to leave.
Pusillin took his tome and his key and carried them back into the city he had escaped.
He waits outside at Lariss Pavilion for somebody to fetch them.

cards.subject: He pulls you onto the altar
lines: The satyr works an altar above a pool, and his Sacrifice teleports a player up onto it and drains them.
You are not damaged by the ritual. You are moved into it.

cards.subject: The thing in the water under it
lines: A water elemental sits in the pool beneath that altar.
It is the only elemental in the whole of Dire Maul that is neither nature nor arcane.
The wiki notes the oddity and offers no explanation. Nobody else has one either.

cards.subject: The tree opens the last door
lines: An Ancient of War stands enslaved in the wing. Kill Zevrim and he changes his name mid-instance.
"At last... Freed from his cursed grasp!" Ask him and he answers "As you wish..." and smashes down the sealed door.
Then he spends the last of himself and goes back to the Dream.

cards.subject: She is not a blood elf here
lines: Every modern source calls her a blood elf warlock. In vanilla she predates blood elves entirely — that model arrives with Burning Crusade.
Her web is described as built out of sacrificial victims, to siphon the wing's corruption into herself.
Pimgib is the imp she casts Enlarge on.

cards.subject: He studied under Xavius
lines: An arcane illusionist trained by the first satyr himself, who came to Feralas after Hyjal to carry on the work.
Corrupting the shrine is what makes him a wildshaper. He did not learn the forest. He took it.

cards.subject: He fights you as three animals
lines: He shifts between all three mid-fight, each with its own kit, and calls imps near the end.
The satyr who corrupts nature fights you by wearing it.

cards.subject: The plant behind him
lines: The Felvine grows at his back and is inert while he lives. Shards can only be taken once he is dead.
Bind on pickup, one per character, and you can loot one without holding the quest at all.
They buy standing with the Shen'dralar.

cards.subject: A ghost you light yourself
lines: A night elf priestess came to Eldre'Thalas carrying a fragment of Lord Valthalak's amulet. Alzzin's forces ambushed and killed her.
Her ghost haunts the hall he sits in, and it is not there until you call it.
You light a brazier after he is dead and she comes back.
